svg.title: Goal loop (smart Ralph loop, board-free): the agent sets its own goal in the host ledger; the goal provider schedules nudges through the bridge

g.text: Goal loop (smart Ralph loop, board-free): the agent sets its own goal in the host ledger; the goal provider schedules nudges through the bridge
token scope: this execution, own bindings;
goal and park need no mandate
go into argv or the system prompt.
stdin: "Your own goal: make tests green. Continue.
While one is pending the goal does not nudge or count turns.
